lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgMn2(HO)2 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell of 28 atoms—Mg4 Mn8 H8 O8—distributed across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Mn centers in octahedral environments with six neighbors (four H, two O), while Mg centers have five neighbors (three H, two O). The Mn octahedra display corner- and edge-sharing, and Mg polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces with Mn octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
